goal_ru: После урока ты сможешь сравнить два телефона, две игры или два языка программирования.
can_do_en: I can compare two things using comparative adjectives.

words.example_en: My new laptop is more powerful.
It's lighter than my old one.

grammar.title_ru: Сравнительная степень: -er / more … than; good → better, bad → worse
grammar.explain_ru: Короткие прилагательные (1 слог) + -er: fast → faster, big → bigger (удвоили g), easy → easier (y → i). Длинные (2+ слога) — more: more expensive, more powerful. «Чем» — than. Неправильные: good → better, bad → worse, far → further. Усилить: much faster, a bit cheaper.
grammar.explain_en: Short adjectives: fast → faster, big → bigger, easy → easier. Long adjectives: more expensive. Irregular: good → better, bad → worse. Use than: Python is easier than C++. much better, a bit cheaper.

examples.en: Python is easier than C++, but C++ is much faster.
examples.ru: Python легче C++, но C++ намного быстрее.

examples.en: The new game is more interesting than the old one.
My internet is worse than yours.
examples.ru: У меня интернет хуже, чем у тебя.

grammar.tutor_notes_ru: Темы-«холивары» подростка: iPhone vs Android, Python vs C++, Minecraft vs Roblox. Ученик должен не просто сравнить, а сказать почему (because). Нейт спорит, требуя аргумент.

phrases.en: In my opinion, … is better because…
It depends on what you need.

questions_en: Which is better for beginners: Python or C++? Why?
Compare your phone with your friend's phone.
Is gaming on PC better than on console?
Which is more difficult: maths or physics?
talk.tutor_notes_ru: Нейт занимает противоположную позицию в любом сравнении, чтобы ученик спорил. Каждое сравнение — с because.

tasks.text: My new laptop is ___ (fast) and ___ (powerful), but it's ___ (expensive) than my old one.

tasks.question: This game is ___ than the first one.

tasks.ask_ru: Послушай без текста. Почему Сэм выбрал телефон Б?
tasks.ask_en: Listen. Why did Sam choose phone B?
tasks.audio: Phone A has a bigger screen and it's a bit cheaper. But phone B is much faster, the camera is better and the battery lasts longer. So I bought phone B.
tasks.question: Почему он выбрал Б?
options: он дешевле и с большим экраном
он быстрее, камера лучше, батарея дольше
tasks.answer: он быстрее, камера лучше, батарея дольше

tasks.ask_ru: Сравни два ноутбука по характеристикам на картинке.

image.prompt_en: Two laptops side by side with spec icons: laptop A small and light with a battery icon showing 10 hours and a price tag 600, laptop B big and heavy with a fast-speed icon, a big screen and a price tag 1200, clean product comparison infographic, only numbers
image.alt_ru: Ноутбук А: маленький, лёгкий, батарея 10 ч, цена 600. Ноутбук Б: большой, тяжёлый, быстрый, большой экран, цена 1200.

tasks.say: Which laptop is better for you? Compare them.
tasks.example: Laptop A is smaller and lighter than laptop B. Its battery lasts longer. Laptop B is faster and its screen is bigger, but it's much more expensive. For school, laptop A is better because I carry it every day.

tasks.ask_ru: Выбери «холивар» и защити свою сторону: 4 сравнения с because.
tasks.ask_en: Pick a side and defend it.
tasks.say: Python or C++? iPhone or Android? Pick one and convince me. I disagree already.
tasks.example: I think C++ is better for olympiads because it's much faster than Python. Python is easier, but programs in Python are slower. C++ is more difficult, but it's more powerful.

homework.about_ru: Сравни две вещи, между которыми ты сейчас выбираешь (игра, гаджет, кружок), — 5 фраз голосом, и скажи, что выберешь.

tasks.ask_ru: Сравнение двух вещей и твой выбор.
tasks.ask_en: Compare two things you are choosing between.
tasks.say: What are you choosing between? Compare them.
tasks.example: I'm choosing between two keyboards. The first one is cheaper and lighter. The second one is more expensive, but it's much better for gaming. I think I'm going to buy the second one.

pass.about_ru: Пройден, если верно 75% заданий урока (вместе с теми, что агент добавит) и в споре (t5) ≥ 4 правильных сравнения с than и аргументом.

review.note_ru: Цены и прилагательные (cheap, expensive), умения (can) — в сравнениях.
